name: train-cs-sk-weighted-w10-s2
description:
RQ6, weight sweep of the recall-weighted loss (experiments/loss.py): identical to
train-cs-sk-weighted except positive_weight = 10, so a missed positive (span, label) pair
costs 10 times an equally confident false alarm. With weight 3 (train-cs-sk-weighted) it
tunes the weight on development data against person F2; the test splits are never read.
Every CNEC 2.0 and UNER Slovak-SNK train example and 10,000 drawn from each OpenPII 1M
train split; 2,000 steps of 16 (about 1.4 passes).
